sloka: अकीर्तिर्निन्द्यते देवैः कीर्तिर्लोकेषु पूज्यते ।कीर्त्यर्थं तु समारम्भः सर्वेषां सुमहात्मनाम् ।। ७.४५.१३ ॥
transliteration: akīrtirnindyate devaiḥ kīrtirlokeṣu pūjyate ।kīrtyarthaṁ tu samārambhaḥ sarveṣāṁ sumahātmanām ।। 7.45.13 ॥

translations.english: Infamy is condemned by the gods, while fame is honored in all worlds, and indeed, all great-souled individuals undertake their endeavors for the sake of renown.
